entries.title: Your project's folder is up to date after a merge
entries.body: After the app merges a pull request, it brings your project's folder on this computer up to date. When a crewmate started or looked for changes at the same moment, this sometimes failed and Activity said the folder was not refreshed. Now it is brought up to date either way.
entries.noPicture: The result is a folder on disk and an Activity line after a merge; no view changes.
